attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (10.10.10.0/24, vtnet1/opt1) and lan-b (10.10.20.0/24, vtnet2/opt2), added static IPs and cross routes on node2 (lan-a, 10.10.10.2) and node3 (lan-b, 10.10.20.2), and added firewall rules to block+log TCP/23 between the two networks while allowing other traffic. Verified a telnet (tcp/23) connection attempt from node2 to node3 is refused and logged on node1's filter log. Then executed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time, confirming boot-identity change and post-restart recovery of interfaces, routes, firewall rules, and the block+log behavior for a fresh attempt from node2.
